opening_hook: Discipline ka chota raaz, Rohan ki kahani!
narration: Rohan ne ek din decide kiya ki woh roz subah 5 baje alarm bajne par phone uthakar ek short meditation karega. Aaj se uska routine set ho gaya: 5 minute timer, focus on breathing, phir ek page likhega apne goal ke baare mein. Pehle din usko lag raha tha ki sab mushkil hai, lekin usne ek choti win dekhi jab uska coffee ka cup perfectly balanced raha. Har roz jab woh uss routine ko repeat karta, uska confidence badhta gaya. Kal jab usko ek important presentation deni thi, uski preparation flawless thi aur usne sabko impress kiya. Discipline ne Rohan ko dikhaya ki choti consistency se badi success milti hai. Remember, small steps lead to big change.
story_beats: Hook: Rohan decides to start a 5 am morning meditation and goal‑writing routine.
Problem: The first session feels overwhelming and he doubts he can keep up.
Conflict: He struggles with the habit, noticing small setbacks like a wobbly coffee cup.
Turning point: A tiny win—his coffee cup stays perfectly balanced—boosts his confidence.
Resolution: Consistent practice sharpens his preparation, leading to a flawless presentation.
Closing message: Small consistency creates big victories—try it yourself!
